description: Differential activation field over FQ_n × C_6 — execution layer: WCR gradient ascent (C=f(b,θ), Yax=∇f selection), Wo unfold (anamorphism/intent declaration), Sek execute (deltaB proposal), product_degree(n)=n+2 (FQ_n degree n+1 + C_6 arc), Laplacian distortion Δf, attractor/void structure, fold edge gradient δf(b,~b), field gap law (f=0→unreachable), gradient component orthogonality (FQ_n component=WCR, C_6 component=ladder). Deliberately covers sparse field regions; does NOT re-cover AC/harvest/attribution cluster (§71) or recognition/canonicalization layer.
